description: Georgia O'Keeffe is walking towards pontoon rafts. Steve Porter, Tish Frank, 'young man', and Kathy Porter are at rafts. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Loading Into Rafts
